name: spaces_duplicate
description: Copy a Space the user can open into a new Space they own. `template: true` when copying a Spaces template. Share `space.webUrl`. @see guides_get('spaces')

projectReference.description: Project the copy is filed in. Defaults to the user's personal space.

spaceId.description: Space UUID from `spaces_list`, or a template board.

template.description: True when copying a Spaces template.
